scope: Final release-readiness source checks, existing record indexes 29–42 only; no catalog or production edits by this researcher.
verificationDefinition: VERIFIED means live official source inspected and recommended retained facts supported, including an explicit older-cycle or unannounced-next-cycle warning where appropriate. It does not promise next-cycle admission or availability. PARTIAL identifies unresolved conflicts in official pages.
methods: Read-only live HTTP fetching and HTML text inspection; HTTP status, retrieval timestamp and body SHA-256 retained as evidence.
Official web search/page extraction used as discovery only where direct retrieval was available. Stale indexed text was rejected when live source differed.
No browser interaction, organizer communication, application login or transaction performed.
